title: Howard Hughes visiting George Van Tassel at Giant Rock

tellings.quote: George Van Tassel used to have Howard Hughes land on his private airirstrip and come eat his wife's ties.

plain: In the 1950s, the rich aviator Howard Hughes is said to have landed on a private airstrip at Giant Rock, a spot in the California desert, to visit its owner George Van Tassel, a man known for UFO gatherings there, and to eat his wife's cooking. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this in passing, without naming a source, and credits a book called Closer Encounters. It would place a powerful businessman close to the early UFO scene.
